answer: We formalize a protocol where participants commit dynamic opportunity-cost bonds as staking collateral, establishing a subgame-perfect slashing matrix that penalizes Byzantine deviation. This architectural reef ensures that identity multiplication triggers exponential resource costs, proving the expected utility for any vine of adversarial nodes is strictly negative. Integrating zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions to extend the security horizon demonstrates that honest coordination forms a unique Nash equilibrium where corruption costs exceed maximum payoff.
